name: sit-post
reply:
Draft X post for the earshot release, with two angles to pick from.

Angle 1: "I stopped reading my agent's replies. I listen to them now. Earshot turns every reply into a 30 second memo and a link I can tap from my phone." Image idea: the player bar with the waveform and the Listen button.

Angle 2: "Your coding agent explains what it did in 600 words. You skim it. Earshot reads it to you and draws the one picture that matters." Image idea: a before and after of a log line.

Both are under 280 characters, fact first, nothing to sell. The caption for the screenshot would be the plain sentence: Reply in, memo and picture out. Tell me which angle to use and I will queue the tweet with the media.
